6.speaker: Player_Romus
6.text: "We are at war, Supreme Wiseman. I would humbly call upon your great warrior culture for assistance."

7.speaker: Player_Romus
7.text: "We are at risk of losing the territory of Zille to Wehlen. I would humbly call upon your great warrior culture for assistance."

12.speaker: Jorga Azmal
12.text: "Judging by how the Duel of Generosity ended, you could use our help."

13.speaker: Jorga Azmal
13.text: "We are happy to help our brethren."

15.speaker: Jorga Azmal
15.text: "We are willing to sell you our latest missile system. Even the Lespians will have trouble competing with it."

16.speaker: Player_Romus
16.text: "I was thinking of something with a little more finesse."

17.speaker: Player_Romus
17.text: "To safeguard God's creations, we must invoke the power of the heavens."

18.speaker: Jorga Azmal
18.text: "In that case, Your Majesty, what you need is human power."

19.speaker: Player_Romus
19.text: "Great. The Palesians won't know what hit them."

20.speaker: Sal Ignacius
20.text: "Remember, these weapons are to be wielded with mercy, not wrath. Correct, Supreme Wiseman?"

21.speaker: Jorga Azmal
21.text: "Derdian mercenaries have helped win wars since the days of the Empire of Moridia."

22.speaker: Jorga Azmal
22.text: "Ah. I am sorry that He has not blessed you with more prosperity."

24.speaker: Jorga Azmal
24.text: "Wrath can be a powerful tool in the hands of the righteous, Grand Wiseman."

25.speaker: Jorga Azmal
25.text: "We can also offer you our finest mercenaries. They have been helping win wars since the days of the Empire of Moridia."

26.speaker: Player_Romus
26.text: "In case of emergency, a surge of Derdian mercenaries could certainly be of service."

27.speaker: Player_Romus
27.text: "We are already deploying my Golden Guard. Your mercenaries would be redundant."

28.speaker: Player_Romus
28.text: "I'm imagining that right now. It scares me."

29.speaker: Jorga Azmal
29.text: "You saw my Disciples earlier. Imagine a larger team, just as trained, wielding sophisticated weaponry and stealth technology."

36.speaker: Jorga Azmal
36.text: "I see. And are all your Golden Guards like Captain Gordion?"

37.speaker: Jorga Azmal
37.text: "If the rest of your Golden Guard is as skilled as Captain Gordion, that may be true."

38.speaker: Player_Romus
38.text: "Can they be relied on to fight for the Rizian Crown?"

39.speaker: Jorga Azmal
39.text: "They will fight for what they believe in, Your Majesty."

42.speaker: Sal Ignacius
42.text: "As long as there is a way to rein them in."

46.speaker: Player_Romus
46.text: "I have no need for your mercenaries. But I will gladly purchase your missiles." [-2 Budget]

51.speaker: Player_Romus
51.text: "Never mind. This is Rizia's war to fight. I don't want Derdia getting involved."

52.speaker: Player_Romus
52.text: "My kingdom does not require a missile system, but we will hire your mercenaries to fight Pales." [-1 Budget]

55.speaker: Jorga Azmal
55.text: "We will help you fight with honor, Your Majesty."

57.speaker: Jorga Azmal
57.text: "Judging by how the Duel of Generosity ended, you could use our help."

58.speaker: Player_Romus
58.text: "I would happily avail myself of either of those services. Alas, my kingdom cannot afford it."

59.speaker: Jorga Azmal
59.text: "I respect your decision, Your Majesty. I wish you strength for the battles ahead."

63.speaker: Jorga Azmal
63.text: "We are happy to help our brethren."

65.speaker: Player_Romus
65.text: "In case of emergency, a surge of Derdian mercenaries could certainly be of service."

66.speaker: Jorga Azmal
66.text: "They will fight for what they believe in, Your Majesty."

67.speaker: Player_Romus
67.text: "Can they be relied on to fight for the Rizian Crown?"

68.speaker: Jorga Azmal
68.text: "My men will not fight for a kingdom that is complicit in the persecution of the Bludish people."

70.speaker: Sal Ignacius
70.text: "As long as there is a way to rein them in."

71.speaker: Player_Romus
71.text: "I'm imagining that right now. It scares me."

72.speaker: Jorga Azmal
72.text: "Our mercenaries have been helping win wars since the days of the Empire of Moridia."

73.speaker: Jorga Azmal
73.text: "You saw my Disciples earlier. Imagine a larger team, just as trained, wielding sophisticated weaponry and stealth technology."

77.speaker: Jorga Azmal
77.text: "Normally, Derdia would charge you for their services. But my Disciples are eager to help Rizia reclaim its land from the anti-Golcondist Wehzeks."

78.speaker: Jorga Azmal
78.text: "I have one major concern. Your cooperation with Wehlen."

79.speaker: Player_Romus
79.text: "Free mercenaries? I can't say no to that. I will accept your aid."

82.speaker: Player_Romus
82.text: "They may do so if they wish. But I don't want them harming civilians."

83.speaker: Jorga Azmal
83.text: "That is not our way, Your Majesty."

84.speaker: Player_Romus
84.text: "Fine. Rizia will withdraw from Wehlen's anti-BFF operations in exchange for the aid of Derdian mercenaries in the Zille resistance movement."

85.speaker: Player_Romus
85.text: "On second thought, I don't want the situation getting out of hand in Zille. Your Disciples should stay out of it."

87.speaker: Sal Ignacius
87.text: "Rizia would never engage in persecution, Supreme Wiseman. Our cooperation with Wehlen is an anti-terrorist measure."

88.speaker: Jorga Azmal
88.text: "It is not 'terror' to defend one's right to exist."

89.speaker: Player_Romus
89.text: "We had no choice. Making that deal with Wehlen was the only way to get Zille back."

90.speaker: Player_Romus
90.text: "I sympathize with what the Bludish have gone through. That does not mean violence is the answer."

91.speaker: Jorga Azmal
91.text: "If you are so confident Zille will be returned through cooperation with Wehlen, why are you even inquiring about my mercenaries?"

92.speaker: Jorga Azmal
92.text: "Then what is the answer? Meekly allowing the eradication of their entire people?"

93.speaker: Jorga Azmal
93.text: "You have the power to end this, Your Majesty. Just say the word."

94.speaker: Player_Romus
94.text: "I fully agree with you. I don't want to aid Wehlen's anti-Blud operations any longer."

95.speaker: Player_Romus
95.text: "We will regretfully be continuing our participation in Wehlen's anti-BFF operations. I withdraw my request for mercenary aid."

97.speaker: Jorga Azmal
97.text: "I don't understand this, Your Majesty. But very well."

98.speaker: Narrator
98.text: Azmal smiled and bowed his head.

100.speaker: Jorga Azmal
100.text: 'St. Wruhec has shown you the way. We are glad to be of assistance."

101.speaker: Player_Romus
101.text: "We have a long war ahead of us. We will purchase both your missiles and the service of your mercenaries." [-3 Budget]

112.speaker: Player_Romus
112.text: "Supreme Wiseman, your missile technology is superior to anything we could achieve in Rizia. I want to purchase one of your systems."

118.speaker: Jorga Azmal
118.text: "Indeed, our defense agency's research and development department is the pride and joy of the Silver Garrison."

119.speaker: Jorga Azmal
119.text: "But I am curious why Rizia is in need of such technology. You are not at war, after all."

120.speaker: Player_Romus
120.text: "Yes, and I want it to stay that way. The more intimidating our weapons, the less our enemies will want to provoke us."

124.speaker: Player_Romus
124.text: "We in Rizia are developing a robust weapons export trade. I can sell these missiles to countries that otherwise would never deal with Derdia."

125.speaker: Player_Romus
125.text: "I fear Merkopa may be on the cusp of a major geopolitical conflict. I don't want to leave Riizia defenseless."

129.speaker: Player_Romus
129.text: "A holy reckoning may soon be at our doorstep. We must be prepared to wield the instruments of justice."

130.speaker: Player_Romus
130.text: "This is an economic move. Rizia can sell these missiles to countries that otherwise would never deal with Derdia."

131.speaker: Jorga Azmal
131.text: "What, so that they may rain back down on our heads?"

133.speaker: Jorga Azmal
133.text: "I am sorry, Your Majesty, but I will have to deny this request. Our missiles were developed in pursuit of peace, not economic gain."

135.speaker: Jorga Azmal
135.text: "With the way things are going in the world, such a reckoning may indeed be close at hand."

136.speaker: Jorga Azmal
136.text: "Yes, I sense it in the air as well. Each of us should be prepared to hold our own against the godless so-called 'superpowers'."

138.speaker: Jorga Azmal
138.text: "Yes, I understand. We ourselves developed this technology in pursuit of peace, not aggression."

139.speaker: Player_Romus
139.text: "I understand that. For such a priceless treasure, I will pay whatever you ask." [-3 Budget]

144.speaker: Jorga Azmal
144.text: "I am prepared to make a deal. But know that this weaponry is the product of years of hard work. It cannot be undervalued."

148.speaker: Sal Ignacius
148.text: "Remember, these weapons are to be wielded with mercy, not wrath. Correct, Supreme Wiseman?"

149.speaker: Jorga Azmal
149.text: "Wrath can be a powerful tool in the hands of the righteous, Grand Wiseman."

150.speaker: Player_Romus
150.text: "Wouldn't you be willing to lower the price as part of a good-faith agreement between men of God?"

152.speaker: Player_Romus
152.text: "I appreciate that. But such a price does not fit in with my economic plans for Rizia."

156.speaker: Jorga Azmal
156.text: "If you truly insist, I will give your kingdom a discount. But only because I trust you to wield it on behalf of all Rizians, including Golcondists."

158.speaker: Player_Romus
158.text: "I will. You have my word." [-2 Budget]

163.speaker: Player_Romus
163.text: "I changed my mind. I'd rather not purchase missiles from you."

164.speaker: Jorga Azmal
164.text: "That is a shame. I assure you, you would have been the envy of GRACE."

165.speaker: Jorga Azmal
165.text: "You are disrespecting our craftsmanship. Perhaps it's for the best that you don't buy it."

167.speaker: Player_Romus
167.text: "Come on, Azmal. Nobody else in Merkopa is willing to trade with Derdia. Any price I offer is the best you're going to get."
